definition: A Microsoft Language Interface Pack provides localized interface text for supported software, sometimes requiring a base language installation.
entry_text: A Microsoft Language Interface Pack provides localized interface text for supported software, sometimes requiring a base language installation.
example: A user installs and selects a display language to read supported menus in that language.
label: Microsoft Language Interface Pack
sense_note: Specific coverage varies by product and package.

sources.note: Microsoft illustrates partial interface localization over a base or parent language for Windows Language Interface Packs; this is not equivalent to a fully localized language pack.
